answers.question: How many model kits have I worked on or bought?
answers.gold: I have worked on or bought five model kits. The scales of the models are: Revell F-15 Eagle (scale not mentioned), Tamiya 1/48 scale Spitfire Mk.V, 1/16 scale German Tiger I tank, 1/72 scale B-29 bomber, and 1/24 scale '69 Camaro.
lines: [2023-05-20] User: I'm looking for some tips on photo-etching for my new 1/72 scale B-29 bomber model kit. I've never tried it before, but I've seen some amazing results online. By the way, I just got this kit and a 1/24 scale '69 Camaro at a model show last weekend.

[2023-05-27] User: I'm looking for some tips on weathering techniques for my model kits. I've been getting back into model building and I recently finished a simple Revell F-15 Eagle kit that I picked up on a whim during a trip to the hobby store in late April.

[2023-05-27] User: I'm still trying to figure out the best way to approach the weathering on my B-29 bomber. I started with a simple Revell F-15 Eagle kit that I picked up on a whim during a trip to the hobby store in late April, and now I'm feeling more confident in my skills, but I want to take it to the next level. Can you recommend any specific weathering techniques or products that would work well on a 1/72 scale model like this?
